pubmed.name: pubmed_search_articles
pubmed.description: Search PubMed for articles matching a query.

query.description: Search query (e.g., "COVID-19 vaccines", "machine learning AND healthcare")

pubmed.name: pubmed_download_article
pubmed.description: Download article details by PubMed ID.

arxiv.name: arxiv_search_papers
arxiv.description: Search arXiv by query, category, date range, and sort order.

query.description: Search query keywords or boolean expression (e.g., "KAN" OR "Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks").

categories.description: List of arXiv categories to filter by (e.g., ["cs.LG", "cs.AI"]).

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

arxiv.name: arxiv_get_abstract
arxiv.description: Fetch metadata and an abstract by arXiv ID without downloading the paper.

wikipedia.name: wikipedia_search_wikipedia
wikipedia.description: Search Wikipedia for articles matching a query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).

wikipedia.name: wikipedia_extract_key_facts
wikipedia.description: Extract bulleted key facts from a Wikipedia article or a specific topic within it.

title.description: The title of the Wikipedia article.

topic_within_article.description: A specific topic within the article to focus fact extraction on.

count.description: Number of key facts to extract (default: 5).

huggingface.name: hf_paper_search
huggingface.description: Find Machine Learning research papers on the Hugging Face hub. Include 'Link to paper' when presenting the results. Consider whether tabulating results matches user intent.

concise_only.description: Return a 2 sentence summary of the abstract. Use for broad search terms.

huggingface.name: hf_model_search
huggingface.description: Find Machine Learning models hosted on Hugging Face. Returns comprehensive information about matching models including downloads, likes, tags, and direct links. Include links to the models in your response.

query.description: Search term. Leave blank and specify "sort" and "limit" to get e.g. "Top 20 trending models".

author.description: Organization or user who created the model (e.g., "google", "meta-llama", "microsoft").

sort.description: Sort order: trendingScore, downloads, likes, createdAt, lastModified.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.
